title: Concept: CakePHP Debug Kit toolbar disclosed
description: DebugKit renders the query log and the session for the current request into the page. Anyone who loads a page with the toolbar can read the SQL that built it, including the bound parameters that carry identifiers and tokens.
applicability: Responses from a CakePHP application deployed with debug mode on.
risk: The caller reads the SQL and its bound values for every page, which exposes identifiers and often credentials held in the session.
